apparatus.gates: unchanged from round 1 (energy/overlap/steady/coordination/pressure_positive/finite); rejection is reported, never overwritten

phi_map.note: 0.01 spacing so that a 2 % (0.02) window is exactly two grid steps

predictions.statement: Reducing the concentration by 2 % (absolute) drops the shear stress by nearly 3 orders of magnitude (Campbell 2002 abstract).
predictions.metric: R2 = max_i tau(phi_i) / tau(phi_i - 0.02) over the phi map, gated points only; tau = |mean sampled shear stress|
predictions.pass_rule: PASS if R2 >= 100 (within one decade of the quoted 1e3); PARTIAL if 10 <= R2 < 100; NOT_SUPPORTED if R2 < 10
predictions.note: order-of-magnitude agreement is the honest target: the quoted 'nearly three orders' is not a number we can reproduce exactly in a 2-D frictional cell

predictions.statement: There is no path from quasi-static to inertial flow by varying the shear rate at fixed concentration: the shear rate exponent n stays small (elastic scaling) at every concentration on the map.
predictions.metric: n(phi) = d ln tau / d ln gamma_dot from the 3-point rate ladder (gamma_dot = 0.5, 1, 2) at phi in {0.80, 0.76, 0.70}
predictions.pass_rule: PASS if max_phi n(phi) <= 0.6 (the inertial/Bagnold value is n = 2); NOT_SUPPORTED if any n(phi) >= 1.2

predictions.statement: The elastic -> purely inertial transition is a switch from contact-borne to collision-borne stress: the kinetic share of the shear stress rises as the concentration falls.
predictions.pass_rule: PASS if Spearman(phi, share) <= -0.8 AND share >= 0.5 at the lowest phi measured; PARTIAL if monotone but share stays < 0.5

controls.seed_twin: at the two phi values bracketing the steepest 2 % drop, one extra point with seed + 1
controls.strain_twin: at the same two phi values, strain_total x 2 (2.8) with the averaging window shifted to 1.4 -> 2.8, to rule out a transient masquerading as a transition

honesty_rules: gate-rejected points are reported with their gate flags and are excluded from the fits; they are never re-labelled as PASS
no parameter is retuned after seeing the verdicts
if a control contradicts a fitted number, the fitted number is withdrawn
